gloss: to get a job; to take up a position

definitions.gloss: to get a job; to take up a position; to enter employment
definitions.explanation: To begin working at a job or to assume an occupational position.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{職|しょく}に{就|つ}く。
examples.english: I'm starting a job next month.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}してすぐに{職|しょく}に{就|つ}いた。
examples.english: I got a job right after graduating from university.

examples.japanese: {希望|きぼう}する{職|しょく}に{就|つ}くために{資格|しかく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got a qualification in order to land the job I wanted.

notes: A formal expression commonly used when discussing employment and career topics. {就|つ}く means to assume or take up (a position). The negative form {職|しょく}に{就|つ}けない (unable to get a job) is also common. Related: {就職|しゅうしょく}する (to find employment — more general), {職|しょく}を{失|うしな}う (to lose one's job).
